source.title: Announcement of a new Senior Delegate - Oceania
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate for Oceania - **Edward Hollingdale**. We would like to thank Tim McMahon for his service as Senior Delegate for the region.


Edward was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.


We wish Edward Hollingdale the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties. His term as Senior Delegate begins today (Nov 1, 2019).


The application document of Edward can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OkF7grfyPMaw791cjnwylnESgMu73Rzu) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: 大洋洲高级代表任命公告
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，**Edward Hollingdale** 将出任大洋洲地区的新任高级代表。感谢 Tim McMahon 担任该地区高级代表期间所做的工作。

WCA 董事会依照[《关于高级代表的议案》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)第 4 节，经董事投票选出 Edward。

祝 Edward Hollingdale 在新的岗位上一切顺利。他的高级代表任期从今天（2019 年 11 月 1 日）开始。

如有兴趣，Edward 的申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OkF7grfyPMaw791cjnwylnESgMu73Rzu)查看。
